entry.title: How we fit a 27B model on a 12 GB laptop GPU
entry.summary: Qwen3.8-27B in 8.31 GB at 2 bits, fully on one 12 GB laptop GPU: what 2-bit means, the real-speed demo, the v2 bit allocation by role and depth learned from DASH-Q, the water-filling idea that failed, and where DASH-Q is better.

entry.title: 8 open models, 77-85% smaller: what 2-bit quantization costs and what it keeps
entry.summary: Eight Pingala-8 2-bit files, Qwen3-0.6B to Qwen3.8-27B: 77-85% smaller than 16-bit, 13-70% lower WikiText-2 perplexity than IQ2_XXS at the same size, speed, perplexity in plain words, and where DASH-Q, IQ2_KT and retrained ternary models beat us.

entry.title: Benchmarking 2-bit GGUFs fairly: paired windows, and the NaN trap on RTX 50 GPUs
entry.summary: How we compare 2-bit GGUF files: same text, 4096-token strided windows, paired per-window NLL with a 95% interval. Why a lower average is not a win (9 of 20 windows), the IQ1_S/IQ2_S/IQ3_S NaN on our RTX 50 GPU and the -ot CPU workaround.

entry.title: Can you run Qwen3.8-27B on a 12 GB GPU?
entry.summary: Yes, with a 2-bit file. Our Pingala-8 v2 file of Qwen3.8-27B (8.31 GB) runs fully on one 12 GB RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU at 37.7 tokens/s; the calculator shows 10.24 GB at context 4096. DASH-Q IQ2_XS (8.55 GB) has better WikiText-2 perplexity, 6.54 against our 6.89; unsloth UD-IQ2_S (8.37 GB) scores 7.34, not significantly different from ours (9/20 windows). Q4_K_M, about 17 GB, does not fit.

entry.title: Qwen3.5-2B under 1 GB: 2-bit GGUFs measured
entry.summary: Six 2-bit GGUF files of Qwen3.5-2B, all under 1 GB, on WikiText-2 (72 windows of 4096 tokens). DASH-Q IQ2_M is first at 13.33 (0.79 GB) and DASH-Q IQ2_XS second at 13.90 (0.76 GB); both are better than our Pingala-8 version 2 at 14.06 (0.78 GB). Version 2 is better than unsloth UD-IQ2_M (14.96) on 67 of 70 windows, UD-IQ2_XXS (23.41) on 70 of 70, and our version 1 (15.62) on 70 of 70.

entry.title: NaN perplexity with IQ1_S, IQ2_S or IQ3_S GGUFs on an RTX 50 laptop GPU
entry.summary: On our RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (sm_120, WSL2), GGUFs with IQ1_S, IQ2_S or IQ3_S tensors gave NaN or a perplexity near 6.8e6 in llama.cpp, and test-backend-ops failed for those CUDA kernels. How to check your GPU, and the -ot CPU workaround that gave correct numbers on our machine.

entry.title: Measured: Qwen3.8-27B in 8.31 GB on a 12 GB GPU
entry.summary: Pingala-8 Qwen3.8-27B version 2: 8.31 GB, runs fully on one 12 GB laptop GPU at 37.7 tokens/s. WikiText-2 perplexity 6.89 vs 7.88 for llama.cpp IQ2_XXS (8.43 GB) and 7.34 for our version 1. DASH-Q IQ2_XS (8.55 GB) is better at 6.54. Needs the patched Pingala-8 llama.cpp runtime (CUDA).

entry.title: Pingala-8: 85% smaller 2-bit LLMs for llama.cpp
